en: Finally, the days of my culinary school are over!
Now I have all day to focus on my work as certified chef!
I have been thinking of opening a shop since the first day at culinary school. I’m so excited the time has come!
I will need someone to accompany me. Will you help me out?
Of course!
That’s the spirit! Now, let’s start our first day!
Welcome to my kitchen! Let me give you a tour!
OK!
Your objective is to earn enough money by cooking delicious food. This is the amount of customers you need to serve today.
A customer has come! Here is the list of ingredients you need to complete the dish.
Swap and make a match of at least 3 ingredients.
Great! Now continue to match more ingredients to complete the dish.
Congratulations! You have finished your first dish! Now click on the Money to collect it.
Please keep in mind to check out each customer’s patient meter. They will leave more tips for you when they are happier!
Ok
One more thing I need to tell you: When you have more than 1 customer at a time, click on their plate to change priority.
I think we’re all set! Let’s keep our customers coming and serve them well!
No problem!
Great job, (player)! I must say that we did really great yesterday!
I can't wait to cook already! Let's start now!
Good news! Do you know Emma, that famous girl in the Home Makeover games? Well, she just came into town to set up a book store!
Cool!
Now we can buy new recipes and upgrade our old ones! Click here to open our recipe book!
Why don’t we try to buy the Deluxe Chicken Croissant recipe?
Click here to see the next recipe in the list.
Click this button to buy it!
Awesome! We just bought a new recipe! Keep buying better ones to increase our restaurant reputation!
Great!
Also, upgrading recipes will increase value of the dish. The more expensive it gets, the more money we will earn!
Remember to visit the Shops anytime you have enough money!
Look at this incredible mess! Who would have thought that we cooked our delicious dishes here in this very kitchen?
No one
You know what they say about always try to have your kitchen clean and tidy, right? Well, that’s quite true because you can’t cook in this mess.
I know you like cooking as much as I do but we still need to clean this up first! The sooner we get this done, the better. Let’s start!
We need to remove most of these items from the kitchen. I have provided the list of items so this will be easy!
There it is, the first item on top of the list. Just click to grab it.
Great! Now, let’s try to use a hint for the second item. Click here to use a hint.
Hints will refill slowly so you can use it over and over again. Very thoughtful, isn’t it?
Yes!
Last tip: you can zoom in and out by dragging your mouse while holding down CTRL key.
Now try to find the rest of the items by yourself. Good luck!
Different customer has different personalities.
Some are more patient but will tip less, while others may get upset faster while queuing but will tip more.
Set your priorities to get maximum profit out of your day.
(player), I have been told that a food critic will visit us today! Oh my gosh!
I heard food critics are the worst kind of customer! They usually order a restaurant’s best dish and demand it to be done quick!
We must make sure everything goes very well today! Let’s do our best!
There he is! The notorious, sour-looking food critic!
He just ordered our most expensive dish with extra add-ons of everything!
We really need a good review from him so let’s work hard to serve whatever he wants!
And remember: Click the food critic’s plate to make his order the top priority.
Very nice job today! I’m so delighted!
Do you want to hear more good news? Guess what, I just found an old recipe for cooking a Chinese menu! Pretty awesome, huh?
I know you can’t wait to try it out, so let’s hit the kitchen when you’re ready!
Congratulations, now you have access to a set of wonderful Chinese delicacies!
Remember that you can always buy new recipes and upgrade ingredients at the shop!
Hey, guess who just opened an Organic Market! It’s Emma again!
Really?
This means we can now upgrade our ingredients, enhancing the taste of our dishes! That also means we can raise the prices of our menu.
Let’s check out her store!
Wow look at all these fresh vegetables! This is heaven for cooks!
Let me give you a tour around here...
This shows the name of the ingredient on display.
You can see more information below, like the Ingredient level, upgrade price and its effect upon purchase.
You can upgrade an ingredient up to 10 levels. I’d recommend to first upgrade the one you use the most.
Let’s try to upgrade this ingredient now. Click the Upgrade button.
Awesome! Now you know how to get the better ingredients for your dishes!
Last tip: Come back here to upgrade regularly to make sure we always serve the best quality to our customers!
Did you know that I am also very good at making frozen yogurt? I just made lots of it!
I’d like to serve my specialty’s frozen yogurt for today and let everyone enjoy it!
So for today, our business is nothing else but froyo!
Come, I’ll walk you through this!
I have prepared everything from cups to yogurts so we’re all set to start!
A customer just came in! Perfect timing!
You can see the kind of froyo he wants here.
Preparing it is very easy. First, select a cup.
Then select the yogurt he wants.
He wants Pomegranate syrup to go with it.
Add some Kiwi.
And finally 1 beverage!
We did it! We just sold our first yogurt ever! That wasn’t so hard, was it?
Just remember that you need to work on it from top to bottom, and from left to right.
And don’t forget to keep an eye of his patience bar. He’ll leave if he waits too long!
You see that sweet baby in the corner? That is our brand new beverage machine! Here, let me show you how it works.
Currently the machine is (juice percentage) complete. It works as we prepare our dishes.
Let’s match this.
Great, a beverage is now ready!
Click the machine and drag to a customer to offer him/her a beverage.
Offering a beverage will increase customer satisfaction which means more earnings for us!
When possible, try to hold off from collecting money right away.
You’ll be rewarded with Chain Bonus if you collect money from all 3 customers at the same time.
Even a small amount will be very helpful to help you reach EXPERT SCORE.
That food critic guy is back to check on us! Let’s show him what we’re made of!
Matching more than 4 ingredients will give you instant bonus money.
As a general rule of thumb, always try to find the longest match as fast as you can.
The faster you match, the shorter time it will take to prepare a dish, which eventually means earning more tips.
(player), I just installed a new French Fries machine on the counter. Now we can serve delicious fries!
It works exactly like the beverage machine, but just in case you forgot, let’s go over it again.
Let’s complete the fries by matching this.
The fries is now ready!
Click the machine and drag to a customer to offer him/her a french fries.
Offering a side dish or drink will increase customer satisfaction, leading to a higher tip!
It’s time to clean our kitchen again!
It’s still hard to believe we made all this mess just in a few days! Let’s work hard to make this place spotless.
There are 10 challenging achievements for you to earn. You should always try to achieve all of them.
Uhoh, the food critic is back. Let’s show him what we got!
Congratulations, now you have access to a set of spicy and exotic Middle Eastern dishes!
It’s time to serve our specialty’s frozen yogurt again! Remember to serve each customer with the right combination as fast as you can to earn more money!
Oh no, our fridge malfunctioned last night and froze some of our fresh ingredients!
No problem, we can manage this.
For each frozen tile, we need an extra step to defrost it. Very simple actually. Try swapping this one.
Now that ingredient has returned back to normal. Problem solved!
I just bought a very helpful tool to help us cook faster and also defrost ingredients easier!
There it is, a chef’s torch! To use it, just swap it to any direction you want. Let’s swap it upwards now.
Very handy, isn’t it?
The chef’s torch will appear in our cooking board from time to time, so keep an eye out for it!
I see a sour-looking face. Must be that food critic again. Let’s see if we can make him smile!
I have good stuff that can keep customers happy for a while: free cookies!
Each time you match 5 or more ingredients, a Cookie will appear. Click on it to boost a customer’s patience.
Customers with the least patience left will accept your generous present and feel a bit happier!
One last thing, you can upgrade its effects from the Shop. Good luck!
It’s time to clean up our kitchen again! Roll up your sleeves and grab your rubber gloves. Let’s get started!
Player, I figure that our tools need a little upgrade.
Agree
Let’s visit a nearby store and see what they have in stock!
Ah, player, look at that shiny French Fries Machine! Don’t you think that would be the best investment to make our restaurant service even better?
But I’ll leave it up for you to decide. If you want to upgrade it, you know now where to go!
